blood_moon.name: Blood Moon
blood_moon.blurb: The moon runs red: elites are far more common, and every kill pays 15% more.

drowned_week.name: Drowned Week
drowned_week.blurb: A cold mist rolls in and the dead arrive in larger waves: 25% bigger, 20% more XP and gold.

tolling.name: The Tolling
tolling.blurb: Every bell in the diocese is ringing: elites come Bell-Tolled, and they drop twice the shards.
